test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The matter is being investigated by the internal committee.

options.text: The internal committee investigates the matter.
The internal committee had investigated the matter.
The internal committee is investigating the matter.
The internal committee has been investigating the matter.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performing the action (introduced by the preposition "by" in the passive sentence) becomes the main subject of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The matter is being investigated by the internal committee."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the doer of the action, "The internal committee," at the beginning as the new subject.
 
• Change the passive verb form "is being investigated" to its active counterpart "is investigating" (present continuous active).
 
• Place the original passive subject "the matter" after the verb to serve as the new object.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The internal committee is investigating the matter."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The internal committee investigates the matter." – Incorrect tense (present simple active).
 
• **Option 2: **"The internal committee had investigated the matter." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
 
• **Option 4: **"The internal committee has been investigating the matter." – Incorrect tense (present perfect continuous active).
